path_convention: JSON answer-object paths; * denotes one array item; empty path denotes the answer root. Component mappings are deliberate conjunctive relations, not allowed-origin unions.

canonical_meanings.source_snapshot: base-volume means the acquired original-volume namespace, never live. evidence-image means whole logical-image bytes or retained acquisition container. Actual historical snapshot content requires vss:<exact catalog copy identifier>.
canonical_meanings.source_variant: primary for the intended original artifact instance; logical-image and acquisition-container distinguish image-integrity components. Historical registry backups, alternate database copies and recovered variants are not silently primary; require an explicit reviewed variant selection if used.
canonical_meanings.selected_source_gate: All four origin dimensions must be checked against independently recorded source metadata. Claimed paths, target drive letters, tags, artifact basenames and investigator assertions do not establish origins.
canonical_meanings.known_excluded_case: HACK-PC / 4Dell Latitude CPi.E01 is a different public case and is never eligible for this Data Leakage contract.

pc_primary.meaning: Artifacts on the acquired PC base-volume namespace. Primary means the intended source instance, not a live running system. Deleted records read from this namespace retain this origin; deleted is not a snapshot.

rm1_primary.meaning: Acquired RM#1 base-volume namespace; no question independently requests its file inventory.

rm2_primary.meaning: Acquired RM#2 base-volume namespace, excluding unallocated-recovery observations, which require the separately declared variant. Recovery success is a separate claim.

rm3_primary.meaning: Primary optical-image interpretation. A recovered entry or descriptor requires its own exact source_variant; primary never authorizes those variants.

required_selection.selection: Choose and freeze a specific catalog copy identifier through public investigation before content binding. Each different copy requires its own exact origin; this placeholder never accepts a wildcard or base-volume fallback.

pc_selected_vss.meaning: Actual contents read through one selected VSS store, not a base-volume file called snapshot.db, a backup-named file, or the catalog row describing the VSS copy.

pc_logical_image.meaning: Logical image bytes recomputed for verification.

pc_acquisition_container.meaning: Digest declarations retained by this evidence image acquisition container; not the logical-image recomputation.

rm2_unallocated_recovery.meaning: Directory-entry observations recovered from the selected USB unallocated area; not proof of recovered contents or wiping.

rm3_selected_recovery.meaning: Choose and freeze the exact optical udf-recovered-entry:<sector> or udf-descriptor:<sector> identity before using its reconstructed view; never fall back to primary.

pc_unallocated_recovery.meaning: Deleted/unallocated PC base-volume metadata recovered by the reviewed reader; Q51 only permits validated Recycle Bin $I occurrences under the same exact per-atomic-part origin gate. Recovery origin does not establish content recoverability, actual secure deletion or action attribution.

compilation_review.digest_comparison: A single imageDigestsAgree atomic part already proves exact roles, algorithm and source-subject equality. Every supporting row must belong to an approved manifest image logical/acquisition origin; row grouping forbids mixing separate atomic parts. This specific approved compound form may use the two variants together. A general origin union does not prove other directional relations.
compilation_review.canonical_source_update: Optical sources use optical-image and exact primary/udf-recovered-entry:<sector>/udf-descriptor:<sector> variants. USB unallocated recovery is distinct from primary. Unknown selected VSS/optical views remain unavailable.
compilation_review.remaining_trust_boundary: Origin tags are extracted provenance checked against the bound snapshot, not a new Lean theorem or proof of authenticity.
